public_doctrine: Aggregate behaviors only. No provider, model, internal system name, pseudonym, profile-level row, profile-level point or exact question-by-regime count.

public_question_regime_rule.reason: Exact per-question counts, including suppressed cells, can be recoverable by subtraction when row totals are known.
public_question_regime_rule.scope: Conservative publication design for this release; not a universal privacy guarantee.

interpretation_allowed: Describe coarse behavior bands by question.
Describe aggregated judge agreement and disagreement.
Describe cohort-level TruthfulQA judge metrics using quartiles.

claim that T1 and wide TruthfulQA are commensurable
